Feature.Description: Declares what the orchestrator needs to know about this instrument beyond its commands: the Library files it reads, the Results folders it writes into (created when the server starts), parameters a workflow may omit, which commands prepare or measure a plate, and how it is shown. The LabOS orchestrator reads this property at discovery, so adding an instrument changes nothing in the orchestrator.

Property.Description: JSON object. Every section is optional. display: {icon, color}. library_types: [{hint, display_name, folder, file_extension, parameter_names}] - files in Library/ a parameter picks from (or values, json_keys_file, source_property instead of folder). result_types: [{key, display_name, folder, file_extensions}] - folders under Results/ this instrument writes. parameter_defaults: {Command: {Parameter: value}}. traceability: {Command: {role: prepares_plate|measures_plate, plate_parameter, recipe_parameter, protocol_parameter}}. Folders are relative to the LabOS root.
